name: Seed Junky Pre-Roll | Lemon Fruz
description: Experience the vibrant taste of Lemon Fruz, a sativa inspired by the finest Italian citrus. With fresh lemon zest, candy sweetness, and earthy undertones, this strain is a terpene-rich delight. Lemon Fruz offers a deliciously refreshing citrus treat, perfect for unwinding while keeping your senses sharp.
